claims.text: Alternative to topical mupirocin or clindamycin: benzoyl peroxide 5% wash for 5 to 7 days when showering
claims.quote: Because most bacterial folliculitis is caused by S. aureus, treatment with topical mupirocin or topical clindamycin is generally effective (1, 2). Alternatively, benzoyl peroxide 5% wash may be used for 5 to 7 days when showering.
